cases.title: Java 17 and later
cases.when: The SDK suites run on Java 17, 21 and the latest LTS, with Kotlin through KSP and kapt
then: All SDK-unit, contract and protocol cases pass

cases.title: Python 3.10 and later
cases.when: The suites run on Python 3.10 to 3.13

cases.title: Node 20 and later with TypeScript 5
cases.when: The suites run on Node 20 and 22 with TypeScript 5, CJS and ESM builds
then: All pass; instanceof works across builds

cases.title: Supported operating systems
cases.when: The packager and dev server run on Linux, macOS and Windows
then: Reproducible descriptors and digests on every OS

cases.title: Tool Host and client versions in the compatibility matrix
cases.when: Packages from each SDK run on every Tool Host and client version in the published matrix
then: Calls succeed or enable rejects with a range error

cases.title: The CLI installs from each ecosystem registry
cases.when: The toolgate CLI is installed from Maven with OS classifier, npm platform packages, Python wheels and the NuGet tool, offline from a mirror
then: Each install verifies its signature and checksum

cases.title: Release pages state conformance, protocol and contracts versions
then: The release page states "Conformance x.y, protocol 2, contracts 1.x" and the release is blocked unless that conformance version passed
